body.name: \(\mathcal O_{\mathbf G}\)
body.construction: \(\mathcal O_{\mathbf G}(I)=\{(A,B,C):A,B,C\subseteq V\text{ are pairwise disjoint and }X_A\perp_{P_I}X_B\mid X_C\}\); by simultaneous I-mixture faithfulness this equals \(\{(A,B,C):\overline A\perp_{d,\mathcal G_{\mathrm m,I}}\overline B\mid\overline C\}\) for every \(I\subseteq V\).
